A letter to you

Words I never stop meaning

Babe,

Four years ago, on a day I didn't know would change everything, I met you. And from that very first moment, I knew there was something different about you — something rare, something I'd been lucky enough to find, and would spend the rest of my life being grateful for.

You are the kindest, most generous, most loving person I have ever known. The way you care — quietly, completely, without condition — is something I will never take for granted. You take care of me in ways I didn't even know I needed. You make me feel, every single day, like the luckiest man alive.

You are my best friend. And I mean that in every sense of the word. You're the first person I want to call. The only person I want beside me — in every adventure, every ordinary Tuesday, every hard day and every brilliant one. I wouldn't do life without you. I don't want to.

On the day I married you, I made you a promise. And I want to say it again, because it's still true. More true, now, than the day I first said it:

"You are my best friend, my confidant, and my greatest support. But most importantly, you are the love of my life. You make me happier than I could ever imagine, and more loved than I ever thought possible. You have made me a better person. I have never been more certain of a decision than wanting to spend the rest of my life with you. I promise to keep our lives exciting, adventurous, fun and full of passion."

And now — now you've given me something I didn't think could exist. Our daughter, Esha. Watching you become her mother has taken my breath away. You were made for this. I already know, without any doubt whatsoever, that she has the most incredible mum in the world.

Esha and I — we are the luckiest, most loved people on this earth. Because we have you.

Happy four years, babe. Here's to every year that comes after this one.

All my love, always — Shaz
Without hesitation

How we got here

Our story, so far

18 March 2022
We met.
The day that quietly changed everything. I just didn't know it yet.
18 March 2023
I asked. You said yes.
Exactly one year to the day. On the same date. There are no coincidences — only us.
20 October 2023
We became husband and wife.
The day I made you every promise I intend to keep. And meant every single word.
10 December 2023
Our wedding in Sri Lanka.
Surrounded by family, tradition, and so much love. A day I will carry with me, always.
9 July 2025
We found out.
A little soul was on her way. Our world quietly became bigger, better, and more whole.
3 March 2026
Esha arrived.
Our greatest chapter began. You became a mother. And I have never loved you more than in that moment.
Us, always
